preconditions.description: The dimensions of the room must be between 1 and 50.
At least one of the dimensions must be even.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'LRUD' for row in current for c in row) and all(c in 'LRUD' for row in desired for c in row)
preconditions.description: The current and desired configurations must only contain valid tile characters.

postconditions.description: The output must either be -1 indicating impossibility or a valid number of operations.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= m for x, y in operations)
postconditions.description: All operations must be within the bounds of the room dimensions.
The number of operations must match the specified count.
